About the Show

Young Sheldon follows a nine-year-old Sheldon Cooper as he starts high school and navigates being a genius in a Texas town that cares more about church and football than physics. An adult narrator looks back on Sheldon's childhood throughout the series, offering commentary on the family's ups and downs.

Did You Know?

The series finale aired as an hour-long send-off, wrapping up Sheldon's Medford childhood with a proper farewell to East Texas.

5 Nights at Sheldon's

Close the door when he's in the hallway. Don't run out of power.

 

Watch the hallway camera. When Sheldon comes creeping down the checkered floor, hit Close Door before he reaches the office — every second it's shut costs power. Run out of power and the door's stuck open. Survive to 6:00 AM.

The Sermon

Move your soul with the arrow keys (or WASD) to dodge inside the box. Survive Pastor Rob's turns, then choose your own.

Undertale-style, Sheldon-flavored: when the box appears, keep your soul away from Pastor Rob's attacks. When it's your turn, choose Fight to deal damage, Act to needle him with a Bible fact, or Mercy once his resolve is low enough to end it peacefully.
